_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. Intelligent Devices (segment principal hardware), Software & Control (croissance software/PlantPAx), Lifecycle Services (services), CA total pour vue d'ensemble.

kpis.signal: Segment hardware principal ~45% CA, variateurs/relais/composants, ralentissement FY24-25 apres pic FY23
kpis.description_fr: Segment hardware (variateurs, relais, drives, composants). ~45% du CA Rockwell. Pic FY23 puis tassement FY24-25 lie a normalisation supply chain.
kpis.description_en: Hardware segment (drives, relays, components). ~45% of Rockwell sales. FY23 peak then FY24-25 softening on supply chain normalization.

kpis.signal: Segment haute marge (~30% operating margin), Logix PLC, FactoryTalk, transformation digitale, re-acceleration FY25
kpis.description_fr: Segment Logix PLC + FactoryTalk + software industriel. Marge la plus elevee. Re-acceleration FY25 (+9%) apres correction FY24.
kpis.description_en: Logix PLC + FactoryTalk + industrial software. Highest margin segment. FY25 re-acceleration (+9%) after FY24 correction.

kpis.signal: Services & solutions, integration Sensia (JV Schlumberger), revenus stables recurrents
kpis.description_fr: Solutions & services (integration, conseil, MES, cybersecurite OT). Inclut JV Sensia avec SLB.
kpis.description_en: Solutions & services (integration, consulting, MES, OT cybersec). Includes Sensia JV with SLB.

kpis.signal: Croissance plate FY25 apres normalisation post-pic FY23, fin du cycle de destockage clients
kpis.description_fr: CA consolide Rockwell Automation. Pic FY23 (9.06 Mds), creux FY24, reprise modeste FY25.
kpis.description_en: Rockwell Automation consolidated revenue. FY23 peak (9.06 Bn), FY24 trough, modest FY25 recovery.
